page_title: AUG 2-3 BAY | Augsburg v Bayern Munich 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's it for today, Christian Dingert has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Manuel Neuer (Bayern Munich) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+7' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is being substituted because of an injury. Thomas Tuchel sends Lovro Zvonarek on the pitch.
90+7' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
90+6' Christian Dingert shows a yellow card to Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) for his blatant foul.
90+5' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+4' 2 - 3 Goal! Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Neuer into the bottom left corner.
90+4' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+3' Christian Dingert blows his whistle and signals a foul after Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) brought his opponent down. Augsburg are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
89' Substitution. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) in, Jamal Musiala out.
89' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) replacing Leroy Sane.
89' Sven Michel (Augsburg) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the right side of the target, but Manuel Neuer pulls off a superb save.
89' Sven Michel (Augsburg) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
88' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Augsburg!
88' Referee Christian Dingert makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Augsburg. Let’s see what happens!
87' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
85' Arne Engels (Augsburg) sends the corner into the box, but Manuel Neuer intercepts it and averts the threat.
84' A pass from Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is intercepted by Finn Dahmen and the move breaks down.
82' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) will deliver the corner kick.
81' Now Bayern Munich have a corner.
81' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
80' Substitution. Ruben Vargas makes his way off the pitch and Sven Michel (Augsburg) comes on as his replacement.
80' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) has tested the patience of referee Christian Dingert and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
79' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

79' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
78' Dion Beljo (Augsburg) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.

76' Dion Beljo sprays a wonderful pass out to Ruben Vargas (Augsburg), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Manuel Neuer problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
75' Substitution. Iago will be replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
75' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
74' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
72' The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
71' Bayern Munich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
69' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Iago (Augsburg) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
67' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Christian Dingert had an easy-decision to make.
62' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) replaces Elvis Rexhbecaj.
62' Here is a change. Fredrik Jensen is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Arne Engels (Augsburg).
62' A substitution has been made. Phillip Tietz is replaced by Dion Beljo (Augsburg).

58' No offside! Referee Christian Dingert points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Bayern Munich players. Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 1:3.
58' The Bayern Munich players joy may have been justified, because referee Christian Dingert is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
58' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) has a goal ruled out for offside!
57' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Finn Dahmen makes a comfortable save.
55' The linesman makes the right call and Bayern Munich will have a corner.

52' 1 - 2 Kevin Mbabu showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 1:2.
52' Augsburg take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
51' The statistic for corner kicks – 1:1.
50' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Finn Dahmen comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' One of the players from Augsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
48' A player from Bayern Munich commits a rough challenge. Christian Dingert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
47' Augsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
46' Referee Christian Dingert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+5' 0 - 2 Leon Goretzka slides a pass towards Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner. The score is now 0:2.
45+4' Bayern Munich control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Chance! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
44' 6:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 3:1.
40' Christian Dingert interrupts the game. One of the players from Augsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
39' Flag up against Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
35' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) tries to find Ermedin Demirovic, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayern Munich.
33' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
31' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Manuel Neuer is alert and denies him.
29' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) forces a pass into the box, but Finn Dahmen is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.

28' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
26' Thomas Tuchel is forced to make a change. Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is unable to continue due to injury, Mathys Tel comes on.
26' The Augsburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
23' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
23' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
20' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Bayern Munich was in an offside position.
20' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Christian Dingert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Augsburg.

15' A sweet pass inside the box gives Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
14' The goal by Augsburg is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
13' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Christian Dingert wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
12' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
11' Dangerous play by Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich). Christian Dingert blows his whistle for a foul.
10' The Bayern Munich players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
8' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
7' Free kick. Augsburg will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
7' The Augsburg players are stunned as referee Christian Dingert changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
6' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
6' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Augsburg using VAR. Let's see what happens.
5' The players claim that Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Augsburg are given a penalty!
3' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
3' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Manuel Neuer.
2' Augsburg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Augsburg will take the kick-off.
Christian Dingert got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
